title: Generative AI and Student Work
description: CAT 531 textbook section connecting generative ai and student work to Design Tension Studio map naming a classroom value conflict and negotiated decision, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Distinguish product evidence from process evidence and explain why generative AI weakened product evidence
Distinguish artifact polish from evidence-based revision
Apply an allowed-use boundary to judge whether a student did the reserved work, rather than whether AI touched the document
Critique AI-detector scores as probabilistic, equity-biased hypotheses rather than integrity evidence

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
